jobs.description: As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients inthe banking sector and financial services industry on complex topicsrelated to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their currentsituation, identify new requirements early on and, together with yourteam, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the wayto implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continueddevelopment of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enablingwell‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matterresponsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape thecontent development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: Yousupport and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financialservices providers in their liquidity and market price riskmanagement, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and thedesign of client-specific solutions through to implementation. Youdevelop integrated management approaches for liquidity and marketprice risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitativemodeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interestrate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you designmethodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) anddevelop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well asnet interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you alsoensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, forinstance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of yourteam and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientationand professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – bothwithin the team and with our clients. You also mentor juniorcolleagues, developing both their professional capabilities andpersonal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. Youactively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consultingportfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage andderive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support thedevelopment of new offerings and the acquisition of new clientmandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented bycertifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years ofprofessional experience in consulting or the financial industry.Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects inliquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, andinitial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinatingteam members) is also part of your profile. You have a solidunderstanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well asthe ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analyticaland quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programmingskills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar withrelevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBAGuidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is aplus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented mannerand communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of workingcomes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility withina team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (atleast B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybridYour benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road withzeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accidentinsurance policy. jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description: The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growthStructural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffractionInvestigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sourcesDetermination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbHSupervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the projectWriting scientific publications for peer-reviewed journalsPresentation of results at national and international conferencesCompleted doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related fieldSolid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solidsKnowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperaturesExperience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostatsDemonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials scienceIndependent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamworkExcellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantageExperience supervising students is an advantageWe offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

jobs.description: Full- or part-time | temporary (24 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und StrahlentherapieThe Department of Radiation Oncology at TUM University hospital is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our Radiation Biology Research Group.Our research focuses on translating novel radiotherapy concepts from experimental models toward clinical application, with a particular emphasis on spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT). We aim to understand the biological mechanisms underlying tumor response and normal-tissue tolerance and to establish the preclinical evidence required for future clinical trials.The position offers the opportunity to work at the interface of radiobiology, radiation oncology, and medical physics within an interdisciplinary translational research environment.Your responsibilities:- Irradiation and dosimetry of mouse cohorts using MBRT and conventional radiation, across single- vs. multi-fraction regimens- Longitudinal neurobehavioral testing - Histological and immunohistochemical analysis of neuroinflammation, vascular, and structural brain changes- Neurotransmitter profiling and biomarker analysis - Statistical and integrative analysis of dose-response and biomarker data to define normal-brain tolerance thresholds- Close collaboration with scientists and clinicians from radiation oncology, medical physics, and radiobiology, and translation of findings into clinically relevant concepts for future MBRT trialsYour profile:- We are looking for a highly motivated scientist with a strong interest in experimental and translational radiation oncology and radiobiology - A doctoral degree in biology, biomedical sciences, veterinary medicine, or a related field is required - Experience with preclinical in vivo models and animal experimentation is desirable - Expertise in tumor cell culture, histology, immunohistochemistry, or molecular biology would be an advantage - A background in radiation biology and radiation-induced normal-tissue effects would be advantageous - The ability to independently plan, conduct, analyze, and document experimental studies is expected - A strong interest in interdisciplinary and translational research at the interface of radiation oncology, medical physics, and biology is essential - Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary research environment are required - Flexibility and mobility to make full use of the scientific opportunities and research infrastructure available across TUM sites (TUM University Hospital Rechts der Isar and the Garching Research Campus) - jobs.description: Introduction: Get ready to embark on an exhilarating journey in the world of mobility technology! This job opportunity invites you to shape the future of parking systems, where you'll be at the forefront of developing a cutting-edge backend, optimizing CI pipelines, and enhancing monitoring with Datadog, all while ensuring the seamless operation of thousands of parking lots. If you're a passionate engineer with a hunger for continuous improvement and proficiency in a variety of programming languages, this is your chance to revolutionize the industry and make a direct impact on our dynamic, tech-driven team. Your Objectives & Role: Drive the Backend Vision: Define and evolve the architecture of our backend systems, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term product strategy. Align Engineering with Strategy: Act as a technical counterpart to product and business stakeholders, translating company objectives into backend initiatives with measurable impact. Drive End-to-End Ownership: Take accountability for backend projects from concept to delivery and beyond, setting the standard for reliability and quality across the lifecycle. Champion Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for clean, performant, and maintainable code; foster a culture of high standards and technical curiosity. Lead & Develop Engineers: Guide backend engineers through mentorship, coaching, and clear technical direction to grow the team’s capabilities and autonomy. Architect for Scale & Resilience: Make critical decisions on system design and performance to support a growing platform with increasing complexity and scale. Elevate Operational Maturity: Lead improvements to monitoring, observability, and developer workflows, ensuring backend systems are resilient and teams can ship confidently. Embed Security by Design: Take responsibility for backend security posture, ensuring systems meet best practices and compliance from the ground up. Be a Force for Innovation: Stay ahead of backend trends and emerging technologies; drive continuous improvement in how we build, scale, and operate our systems. Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset: Real Seniority: Not defined by years of experience but by a drive for continuous improvement, direct business impact, and ownership. Backend Development: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, Node.js, and backend frameworks such as NestJS, Flask, Fastify, or FastAPI. Cloud Expertise: Hands-on experience with AWS services like RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, EC2, and SQS. Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform or similar tools for infrastructure automation. High-Throughput Systems: Strong experience in real production projects handling large-scale data flows. Monitoring & Observability: Proficiency in tools like Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana. Security & Networking: Solid understanding of networking principles, security best practices, and cloud security. Agile & Fast-Paced Environments: Experience in agile teams, working in dynamic, fast-growing tech environments. Excellent Communication: Strong English communication skills (C1+), with the ability to collaborate across teams. German proficiency is not required. Technologies We Work With: Event-driven backend development in Python and NestJS, following a microservice architecture Frontend monorepo with Turbo, pnpm, changesets, and storybook, primarily using Vue.js Adoption of TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ, and Prisma for backends in an opinionated monorepo approach Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, S3 Container orchestration with Kubernetes and CI/CD using GitLab Infrastructure provisioning on AWS using Terraform Leveraging the serverless framework on AWS Lambda for high-throughput endpoints Work Setup: Hours: 40 hours per week (based on trust) Home Office Policy: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote Contract: Permanent contract Location: Munich What We Offer: We believe in supporting our team with an environment that fosters growth, well-being, and a great work-life balance.Your Ideal Setup: MacBook (M4 Pro, 48GB Ram) and a 37-inch curved screen. Dynamic Culture: Enjoy a true startup atmosphere with flat hierarchies, agile teams, and a diverse, international group of colleagues. Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours and the option to work from home or our state-of-the-art Munich office with standing desks. Competitive Compensation: A strong competitive salary that recognizes your expertise. Future Planning: A solid company pension plan. Foodie Perks: Daily meal allowance, weekly free team lunch, a well-stocked cereal bar, and complimentary drinks. Health & Wellness: Job bike program and access to premium sports and fitness facilities via EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club membership across Germany. Continuous Growth: Ample professional development opportunities to sharpen your skills. Language Support: German language learning opportunities. Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy special discounts on various branded products through Corporate Benefits. Our Recruiting Process: Initial Contact: We’ll get back to you within 48 hours. HR Interview: Discuss your experience and expectations. Live Assessment: Showcase your skills in a technical challenge. CTO Interview: Deep dive into the role and expectations. On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office and meet the team.
